coverage_exempt.reason: Original 0x4df828-0x4df830 copies measured width at local+0x84, and 0x4df842-0x4df861 calls IntersectRect with bounds (0,0,width,height), aliasing its other input/output. A successful physical intersection has right <= measured width. The unchanged signed compare at 0x4df87a therefore always takes JLE; the right clamp cannot execute.

Original 0x4df82c-0x4df83b copies measured height at local+0x88, and 0x4df842-0x4df861 intersects the input/output rectangle with (0,0,width,height). On physical success bottom <= measured height; no call or write intervenes before signed compare 0x4df890, so JLE always skips this bottom clamp.

equivalent_mutants.reason: Checked original 0x4dff40-0x4dff46: signed CMP maximum,height conditionally copies height into the EAX maximum. Changing <= to < only omits that register assignment when both bit-identical signed32 operands are equal. No memory write, call, flag-dependent descendant or alternate value occurs on this equality path; subsequent slot/count updates and returned maximum are identical for every permitted input.

Deleting this store cannot affect any permitted input.
